title: Microscopic signed fields and empirical Poisson laws
summary: Quantitative comparison of the actual position/excess/sign field at growing intensity, retaining the original small-prime conditioning; same-grid dyadic restriction and common measurable readouts. Along literal dyadic scales, empirical window counts converge almost surely to Poisson, while empirical full vectors have a positive total-variation obstruction.
